subject: Coordination: Next steps + rotating demo cadence (US / EU / APAC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna.li@novacorp.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposing rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Anna / Samir + team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Recap (30m discovery):
- You’re evaluating inference for a multi-region feature (search & summarization) with tight SLOs for US and EU customers, and a pilot in APAC later this year.
- Key constraints: SSO + SOC2 evidence, cost target ~$0.0004/token, and a requirement for predictable daytime support for EU.
- Primary stakeholders: Anna (product), Samir (platform), Tina (security — not on this call).

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) Technical deep dive + demo (45–60m): live walkthrough of model selection, routing/fallback, and cost controls.
2) Security sync (Tina + our infosec) — short meeting for the questionnaire and logs.
3) Commercial touchpoint (SOW draft + capacity sizing) — we’ll share a starter SOW after the demo.

Scheduling ask: Because you have teams across the US / EU / APAC, we propose a rotating demo cadence so different stakeholders can attend without forcing late nights. A sample rotation we can run as a pilot (3-week rotation):
- Week A (US-friendly): 9:00–10:00 PT (17:00–18:00 CET)
- Week B (EU-friendly): 17:00–18:00 CET (09:00–10:00 PT)
- Week C (APAC-friendly): 10:00–11:00 SGT (18:00–19:00 CET)

Options for next meeting: please reply with the week(s) that work or pick a slot from the poll we’ll send. If you prefer a single fixed time, we can lock that instead.

I’ll include Ben (solutions) and Naomi (CS) on logistics — they’ll coordinate invites and the SOW starter.

Attachments: short demo brief + example SOW (draft) will follow in my next email.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Anna Li <anna.li@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposing rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes from our side: 

- The rotation idea sounds good. We’d like a recurring cadence (pilot for 6 weeks) so our PMs and platform engineers can attend at least one live session without repeated late evenings.
- Tina (security) will join the security sync; I’ll loop her in on the next thread.
- For the demo: Tuesday or Thursday works best for us. 

Suggested slots for the first three weeks (we’re PST folks and CET folks will widen time):
- Candidate 1: Tue 9:00 PT / 18:00 CET (US-friendly)
- Candidate 2: Thu 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT (EU-friendly — earlier for US)
- Candidate 3: Wed 10:00 SGT / 02:00 CET (APAC — appears early for EU but OK for APAC engineering)

I’ll ask Tina (security) to confirm availability; if you can share a Doodle or calendar poll, we’ll pick the earliest mutual slot.

—Anna
Anna Li
Director of Product, Novacorp
anna.li@novacorp.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Anna Li <anna.li@novacorp.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposing rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Thanks Anna — and thanks Marissa. A couple pragmatic suggestions from our side to make the rotation low-friction: 

1) Pilot plan (6 weeks): run a 6-week pilot with a 3-week repeated rotation (US / EU / APAC). That gives everyone at least two opportunities to attend a friendly-time session.
2) Calendar tooling: we’ll send a short Google poll with 3 candidate slots per week and automatically create a recurring calendar series once a preferred pattern is chosen.
3) Attendance guide: we’ll record each demo and publish a 5–7 minute highlight clip for people who can’t attend; recordings will be linked in the HubSpot deal record.

I’ve drafted a simple rotation policy below — feel free to amend: 
- Week 1 (US): Tue 09:00 PT — target audience: US PMs + platform engineers
- Week 2 (EU): Thu 16:00 CET — target audience: EU PMs + security
- Week 3 (APAC): Wed 10:00 SGT — target audience: APAC engineering

If that looks good, Marissa / Naomi — can you: 1) send the poll, 2) attach the demo brief and SOW starter, and 3) propose a first date (we recommend starting the pilot week of July 22). I’ll draft the calendar series after Anna confirms the preference.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
